plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure, aligning with capital preservation.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Increase QQQI to 25% to favor income and broad index exposure.
Add to CRWD, bringing it to 15%, as a top-quality name with a strong uptrend.
This plan aims for capital preservation and a large cash buffer.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces overall portfolio risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings. Expect steady, but modest, returns with reduced volatility.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce overall leverage, addressing their below-stop status.
Reduce SPY to 25% to cure the concentration breach and align with the mandate.
Increase CRWD to 18% as a quality tech name with a strong uptrend.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 22%, to blend broad index and income exposure.
This plan aims for risk-first growth with a moderate cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while blending broad index and quality tech. Expect moderate returns with controlled risk, maintaining a cash buffer.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, bringing each to 6%, to lean into leveraged ETFs for aggressive growth.
Trim SPY to 25% to cure the concentration breach and meet the mandate.
Increase CRWD to 20% as a top-scoring scanner setup with a strong uptrend.
Buy TECS at 5% as a new high-scoring scanner setup to add exposure.
This plan uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups for stretch growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth by using and adding leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-scoring setups. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lose a lot fast; strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero, eliminating all leveraged ETFs for income focus.
Increase QQQI to 30% to prioritize income and covered-call exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration while maintaining broad index exposure.
Reduce QQQ to 10% to shift away from growth and towards income-generating assets.
This plan aims to park cash for yield with a focus on monthly distributions.
income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield and steady monthly distributions. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth, cutting leverage and high-beta names. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
